description:
Edits multiple independent parts of one existing file in a single atomic update.

Usage:
- Every edits[] item is matched against the original file content before any replacement is applied
- oldString must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation)
- read output prefixes every line with a line number and a tab — that prefix is not part of the file; strip it before using line content in oldString/newString
- If oldString appears multiple times, provide more surrounding context to make it unique
- Set replaceAll=true to replace every occurrence matched in the original file
- Read every required line range before editing
- All edits must be independent and target non-overlapping original ranges
- Array order does not make edits sequential: an edit cannot match text produced or changed by another edit
- If any edit fails to match the original file, depends on another edit's output, or overlaps another edit, the entire call fails without changing the file
- For a writable knowledge file that lacks frontmatter, Locus generates it after the edit and reports every generated field plus the final content start line
- Successful knowledge edits update the index before returning
- When C# code analysis and edit/write diagnostics are enabled, successful .cs edits append capped file-scope diagnostics automatically

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to modify

edits.description: Independent replacement operations for this file. Every operation is resolved against the same original content.

oldString.description: The exact original text to find and replace

newString.description: The text to replace the matched original range with

replaceAll.description: Replace every original occurrence. Default is false.
